test_to_datetime_format: test to_datetime with format parameter to parse date strings like %d/%m/%Y or %m/%d/%Y
test_to_datetime_mixed_offsets: test to_datetime raises ValueError on mixed timezones without utc=True parameter
test_to_datetime_unit: test to_datetime with unit parameter converts numeric epoch values to DatetimeIndex
test_to_datetime_dataframe: test to_datetime assembles DatetimeIndex from DataFrame columns with year, month, day keys
test_to_datetime_coerce: test to_datetime with errors=coerce converts unparseable values to NaT instead of raising
